breakdown.title: Snow in the Office
breakdown.logline: Snow falls inside an office, burying everything in white while no one notices; the dreamer's manager turns into a snowman, and the dream ends with the dreamer holding a glowing snowball.

m3.text: The shot is seen from behind the dreamer, about two metres back, at the height of the dreamer's eyes, with a 35mm lens, looking straight ahead at the dreamer's desk and the wall with the door. In the foreground, the dreamer is centered, seen from the knees up, their back to the camera, filling the frame from near the top to the bottom edge, sitting still at the desk. In the middle distance, the dreamer's desk sits directly in front of them, also centered, filling from the middle of the picture to the bottom edge, partly hidden by the dreamer's body, its surface covered with a layer of snow. In the background, the wall with the door spans the entire picture from left to right, its plain surface visible above and to the sides of the dreamer, the door closed and set into the wall. The light comes from the ceiling panels overhead, filtered through the snow that continues to fall gently inside the office, giving a soft even illumination. Just outside the picture to the right, the rest of the office is buried in deep snow, only the tops of monitors showing above the white blanket, with a few coworkers still working, their backs to the dreamer.
m3.view: Seen from behind the dreamer, about 2 metres off, at the height of the dreamer's eyes: the camera looks at the dreamer's desk, toward the wall with the door. A 35mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the dreamer, the middle of the picture, their back to the camera, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from near its top to its bottom edge. Nobody else is in the picture. Also in the picture: the dreamer's desk, the middle of the picture, filling the picture from its middle to its bottom edge, partly hidden behind the dreamer. Outside the picture, off to the right: the office interior with desks, monitors, and people working. Outside the picture, off to the right: the office buried in snow, only monitor tops visible. Across the picture from the left edge to the right edge: the wall with the door, the front of the place.

m5.text: The shot is from about two metres in front of the dreamer, at eye height, angled downward toward the snowball, with a 50mm lens. In the foreground, the dreamer's desk fills the bottom of the picture from left edge to right edge, close enough to be slightly out of focus; just behind it, the dreamer stands facing the camera, seen from shoulders to knees, filling the upper two-thirds of the picture from the top edge, with their body spanning from the left third to the right third and their head out of frame above. In the dreamer's hands, in the left third of the picture and from the vertical middle down to two-thirds, they hold a snowball, which is in sharp focus; the dreamer themselves is slightly soft. Behind the dreamer, the back of the office is a white snow-covered wall or simply white space, with no other people or objects visible. The light comes from the snowball, which glows, illuminating the dreamer's hands and the surrounding area. Off to the left, outside the picture, a coffee mug sits on the desk, and beyond it the office interior with desks and monitors is buried in snow, only the tops of monitors visible.
